rows.text: The party reports that the presidential election was counted on 28 September 2009 and 谷垣禎一候補 was chosen as the 24th LDP president with 300 votes (Diet-member votes 120, party-member votes 180); the Diet members voted from 14:00 at the eighth-floor hall of party headquarters; 河野太郎候補 received 144 (35, 109) and 西村康稔候補 54 (43, 11).

locator.section: date line 【平成２１年 ９月２８日】; headline; first paragraph

rows.text: About 40 minutes after the voting began, 野田毅総裁選挙管理委員長 announced the result together with the already counted party-member votes and declared 谷垣候補 elected (谷垣候補の当選を宣言).

locator.section: first paragraph, sentence beginning 投票開始から約４０分後

rows.text: At the joint plenary meeting in place of a party convention that followed (引き続き行われた「党大会に代わる両院議員総会」), 谷垣新総裁 gave an address pledging to lead the party's renewal and its return to government.

locator.section: first paragraph, sentence beginning 引き続き行われた

rows.text: Afterwards 麻生太郎前総裁 and the two other candidates went up on the platform and shook hands with 谷垣新総裁.

locator.section: first paragraph, sentence beginning その後、麻生太郎前総裁
